author: andrew-demchenk0
description: A input with shadow and password styling.
howItWorks: Click into it (or tab to it) and it lights up while it has focus.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Polite Stingray 67</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by andrew-demchenk0 - https://uiverse.io/andrew-demchenk0/polite-stingray-67 */
/* From Uiverse.io by andrew-demchenk0 - Tags: input, shadow, password */
.input {
  --input-focus: #2d8cf0;
  --font-color: #323232;
  --font-color-sub: #666;
  --bg-color: #fff;
  --main-color: #323232;
  width: 200px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 2px solid var(--main-color);
  background-color: var(--bg-color);
  box-shadow: 4px 4px var(--main-color);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--font-color);
  padding: 5px 10px;
  outline: none;
}

.input::placeholder {
  color: var(--font-color-sub);
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.input:focus {
  border: 2px solid var(--input-focus);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="password" placeholder="Password" name="text" class="input">
</body>
</html>
